mod.name: Production Tuner
mod.description: Adjusts processing speeds, throughput, hydraulic rates and capacities for all machines, tools and vehicles.
config.general.advancedmode.name: Advanced Mode
config.general.advancedmode.desc: Off (default): one slider per group. On: individual sliders per component and parameter type.
config.general.autoscale.name: Auto-Scale Dependent Inputs
config.general.autoscale.desc: Automatically scales dependent devices (pan, wave table, magnetite separator, trailers) to at least the bucket multiplier to prevent material loss.
config.group1.section: Group 1 - Hand Tools & Mobile Wash Plants
config.group1.group.name: Group Multiplier
config.group1.group.desc: Shared multiplier for all hand tools and mobile wash plants (shovel, bucket, pan, hog pan, mobile wash plant).
config.group1.shovel.name: Shovel Fill Speed
config.group1.shovel.desc: How fast the shovel picks up material.
config.group1.bucket.name: Bucket Capacity
config.group1.bucket.desc: Maximum fill volume of the bucket.
config.group1.pan.name: Pan Capacity
config.group1.pan.desc: Maximum fill volume of the gold panning pan.
config.group1.hogpan.name: Hog Pan Capacity
config.group1.hogpan.desc: Maximum fill volume of the hog pan.
config.group1.mobilewash.name: Mobile Wash Plant Speed
config.group1.mobilewash.desc: Processing speed of the mobile wash plant.
config.group2.group.name: Group Multiplier
config.group2.group.desc: Shared multiplier for all construction vehicles and the mobile conveyor belt.
config.group2.minibagger.name: Mini Excavator Dig Speed
config.group2.minibagger.desc: How fast the mini excavator digs.
config.group2.bagger.name: Excavator Dig Speed
config.group2.radlader.name: Wheel Loader Speed
config.group2.radlader.desc: How fast the wheel loader picks up and dumps material.
config.group2.baggerlader.name: Backhoe Loader Speed
config.group2.baggerlader.desc: How fast the backhoe loader picks up and dumps material.
config.group2.mobileconveyor.name: Mobile Conveyor Speed
config.group2.mobileconveyor.desc: Transport speed of the mobile conveyor belt.
config.group3.group.name: Group Multiplier
config.group3.group.desc: Shared multiplier for all wash plant modules (hopper, conveyors, vibrating screen, derocker, sluice, trommel, jig, miner's moss).
config.group3.hopper.name: Hopper Capacity
config.group3.hopper.desc: Fill capacity of the feed hopper.
config.group3.conveyor.name: Conveyor Belt Speed
config.group3.conveyor.desc: Transport speed of stationary conveyor belts.
config.group3.vibratingscreen.name: Vibrating Screen Speed
config.group3.vibratingscreen.desc: Screening throughput of the vibrating screen.
config.group3.derocker.name: Derocker Speed
config.group3.sluice.name: Sluice Box Throughput
config.group3.sluice.desc: Material flow rate through the sluice box.
config.group3.trommel.name: Trommel Speed
config.group3.trommel.desc: Rotation speed of the trommel wash plant.
config.group3.jig.name: Jig Speed
config.group3.minersmoss.name: Miner's Moss Capacity
config.group3.minersmoss.desc: Gold retention capacity of the miner's moss mats.
config.group4.group.name: Group Multiplier
config.group4.group.desc: Shared multiplier for all fine processing equipment (nuggetator, magnetite separator, wave table).
config.group4.nuggetator.name: Nuggetator Speed
config.group4.magnetite.name: Magnetite Separator Speed
config.group4.magnetite.desc: Separation speed of the magnetite separator.
config.group4.wavetable.name: Wave Table Speed
config.group4.wavetable.desc: Vibration speed of the wave table.
config.group4.wavetablecap.name: Wave Table Capacity
config.group4.wavetablecap.desc: Maximum material volume on the wave table.
config.group5.group.name: Group Multiplier
config.group5.group.desc: Shared multiplier for all trailers (magnetite trailer, fuel trailer).
config.group5.magnetitetrailer.name: Magnetite Trailer Capacity
config.group5.magnetitetrailer.desc: Load capacity of the magnetite trailer.
config.group5.fueltrailer.name: Fuel Trailer Capacity
config.group5.fueltrailer.desc: Load capacity of the fuel trailer.
